tbesh_html:
1) secrecy, mystery, enchantment
1a) secrecy, secretly
1b) mystery, enchantment
Also means: lat (לָאט "secret" H3814)

strongs_1890.strongs_def: properly, covered, i.e. secret; by implication, incantation; also secrecy or (adverb) covertly
strongs_1890.derivation: a form of H3814 (לָאט) or else participle from H3874 (לוּט);
